title: More with Less: Efficient Parallel Scientific Code Translation via an Agent-Skill Workflow
abstract: arXiv:2611.08947v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Translating parallel scientific codes between HPC programming frameworks is a critical but labor-intensive task. Existing LLM-based approaches rely on fixed sequential pipelines with undifferentiated repair strategies and correctness criteria that do not match scientific computing practice. We present an agent-skill framework that separates translation, compilation diagnosis, and execution validation into three autonomous agents coordinated by a verdict-driven orchestrator, routing each failure to a targeted repair skill rather than retrying blindly. An automated output check drives the self-correction loop, complemented by an offline LLM-based verification that exposes false positives escaping compiler and runtime checks. We evaluate the framework on 30 HeCBench kernels translated bidirectionally among CUDA, OpenMP, and SYCL with three open-source LLMs. Our framework attains the higher verified correctness rate in all 18 model and dir

translated_title: 以少胜多：基于智能体-技能工作流的高效并行科学代码翻译
translated_abstract: 在高性能计算（HPC）编程框架之间翻译并行科学代码是一项关键但耗时费力的任务。现有的基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法依赖于固定的顺序流水线，采用无差别的修复策略，且其正确性判定标准与科学计算的实际需求不匹配。我们提出了一种智能体-技能框架，将翻译、编译诊断和执行验证分离为三个自主智能体，由一个基于判定结果的编排器进行协调，将每次失败路由到针对性的修复技能，而非盲目重试。自动化输出检查驱动自校正循环，并辅以基于LLM的离线验证，以暴露逃过编译器和运行时检查的假阳性结果。我们在30个HeCBench核函数上使用三个开源LLM评估了该框架在CUDA、OpenMP和SYCL之间的双向翻译性能。我们的框架在所有18种模型与方向组合中都取得了更高的经验证正确率。
tldr: 提出了一种由编排器协调的智能体-技能工作流框架，通过分离翻译、编译诊断与执行验证三个自主智能体并实施针对性修复策略，显著提升了CUDA、OpenMP和SYCL之间并行科学代码翻译的经验证正确率。
en_tdlr: Proposes an agent-skill workflow framework with three autonomous agents coordinated by a verdict-driven orchestrator, using targeted repair skills to achieve higher verified correctness rates in translating parallel scientific codes across CUDA, OpenMP, and SYCL.
